# ui::SpringAnimation

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

A spring: a damped harmonic oscillator pulled to `final_value` (on a scalar property, `final_value.x`). `period` is the undamped period, `damping_ratio` 0..1 from undamped to critically damped (above 1 overdamped). It starts from the property's current value. When it replaces a running spring it also takes that spring's velocity, so a hover spring hands off smoothly.

Example: 
```cpp
// Hover grow: spring to 1.1 on enter, back to 1 on exit.
auto               stack  = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
ui::ButtonControl* button = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("Hover me"));
button->on_pointer_entered([button] {
    button->start_animation(ui::AnimatedProperty::Scale,
                            ui::SpringAnimation{.final_value = ui::Vector3{1.1f, 1.1f, 1.0f}});
});
button->on_pointer_exited([button] {
    button->start_animation(ui::AnimatedProperty::Scale,
                            ui::SpringAnimation{.final_value = ui::Vector3{1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f}});
});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `final_value` | `Vector3` | `{1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f}` | The rest value the spring pulls to; a scalar property uses `.x`. |
| `damping_ratio` | `float` | `0.6f` | 0 never settles, 1 is critically damped, above 1 is overdamped. |
| `period` | `Duration` | `{50.0}` | Undamped oscillation period; shorter is stiffer. |
| `initial_value` | `std::optional<Vector3>` |  | Overrides the start value; unset starts from the property's current value. |
| `initial_velocity` | `std::optional<Vector3>` |  | Overrides the start velocity (units per second); unset inherits a replaced spring's. |
| `on_completed` | `Callback<void()>` |  | Fires once the spring has settled on `final_value`. |
